sloka: एष प्राप्तो दशग्रीवो मम भ्राता महाबलः ।सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी साहाय्ये त्वां वृणोति च ।। ७.२५.४७ ॥
transliteration: eṣa prāpto daśagrīvo mama bhrātā mahābalaḥ ।suralokajayākāṅkṣī sāhāyye tvāṁ vṛṇoti ca ।। 7.25.47 ॥

translations.english: My very powerful brother Dashagriva has arrived, desirous of conquering the world of the gods, and he requests your assistance.
